site.title: Choose an outfall
site.description: Coordinates identify the discharge point. Check its location on a map before choosing: a matching river name does not establish that the outfall is upstream of you. Add the integration again to monitor more outfalls.

manual.title: Choose an individual outfall (advanced)
manual.description: Choose the sewerage company and enter part of a receiving river name or outfall ID. This version covers the companies in England's National Storm Overflow Hub. Reports indicate overflow activity, not measured river water quality.

area.title: What should we monitor?
area.description: Choose a directed river watch or a geographic coastal area. Coastal watches use a radius around your location and group nearby beach and coastal outfalls.

coast.title: Choose the coastal monitoring radius
coast.description: This finds reported outfalls within the radius around your location, regardless of the receiving water name. It is a geographic coastal watch, not a model of tide, currents or bathing-water quality.

coordinates.title: Your location
coordinates.description: Coordinates are prefilled from your Home Assistant home location. Adjust them to a riverside location if needed. Current discharge coverage is England; river routing excludes tidal rivers and canals.

postcode.title: Enter your postcode
postcode.description: Your postcode is sent to Postcodes.io once during setup to find coordinates.

town.title: Find your town or village
town.description: Your search is sent to Postcodes.io. Choose the correct place in the next step.

place.title: Confirm your location
place.description: Town and postcode coordinates are approximate. You will choose a river or coastal watch next.

river.title: Choose the river section and upstream range
river.description: The nearest supported section is selected by default. Coordinates identify the point on the river being monitored. Range is distance ALONG the river, including connected upstream tributaries, not a circle around your home. Open river mapping can omit small streams; tidal sections and canals are excluded.

confirm.title: Confirm upstream monitoring
confirm.description:
Monitor {count} matched outfalls in the {range} km {river} watch at {latitude}, {longitude}.

{outfalls}

River matches follow the mapped network and include connected upstream links. Coastal matches use geographic distance around the location. Coverage is limited to supported English water-company feeds and is not exhaustive.

The selected set is saved at setup; recreate this watch to change location/range or discover new outfalls.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to read the water company's feed. Try again later.
error.no_results: No matching outfalls. Try a shorter river name, an outfall ID, or another company.
error.too_many_results: Too many matches. Enter a more specific river name or an outfall ID.
error.empty_search: Enter a river name or outfall ID.
error.invalid_site: Choose an outfall from the list.
error.location_not_found: No location found. Check the postcode or town name.
error.outside_coverage: This location is outside the current search area. Discharge feeds currently cover England.
error.no_rivers: No supported non-tidal river found within 5 km. Try coordinates nearer the river.
error.discovery_failed: Unable to complete river tracing and check all company feeds. Retry or use a smaller range.
error.no_upstream_outfalls: No unambiguous upstream outfalls found in the supported feeds. Try another river section or a larger range. This does not mean there are no discharges.
error.too_many_outfalls: More than 100 upstream outfalls were found. Reduce the upstream range.
error.no_coastal_outfalls: No supported outfalls were found within this coastal radius. Try a larger radius or check the location.
error.too_many_coastal_outfalls: More than 100 coastal outfalls were found. Reduce the radius.
